# AI 3D generation APIs: Tripo, Tencent Hunyuan 3D, Meshy

Researched 2026-11-14 from the official docs, fetched that day. No account was created and no key was used, so nothing here has been tested against the live APIs.
Notes in **[UNCONFIRMED]** mark things the docs don't state outright (inferred, missing, or contradictory).

Quick comparison:

| | Tripo | Hunyuan 3D (Tencent Cloud intl) | Meshy |
|---|---|---|---|
| Credential | one API key (`tsk_...`) | **pair**: SecretId (`AKID...`) + SecretKey, plus Region | one API key (`msy_...`) |
| Header | `Authorization: Bearer <key>` | `Authorization: TC3-HMAC-SHA256 Credential=...` (signed per request) + `X-TC-*` headers | `Authorization: Bearer <key>` |
| Base URL | `https://openapi.tripo3d.ai/v3` | `https://hunyuan.intl.tencentcloudapi.com/` (POST `/`, action in header) | `https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/` |
| Image input | URL, `file_token` (upload first), or a prior task_id | URL or Base64 | URL or `data:` URI (base64), or a prior task_id |
| Model input (post-processing) | task_id, file_token, or URL | **URL only** (no upload API) | task_id, URL, or data URI |
| Async | POST → `task_id` → GET `/v3/tasks/{id}` | `Submit*Job` → `JobId` → `Query*Job`/`Describe*Job` | POST → `result` (id) → GET `/{endpoint}/{id}`, or SSE `/stream` |
| Status values | `queued`, `running`, `success`, `failed`, `cancelled` | `WAIT`, `RUN`, `DONE`, `FAIL` | `PENDING`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `SUCCEEDED`, `FAILED`, `CANCELED` |
| Free key check | `GET /v3/account/balance` | none for 3D credits; `DescribeAccountBalance` (billing API) checks the key pair | `GET /openapi/v1/balance` |
| Result URL life | temporary signed URL, lifetime not documented | 24 h | until `expires_at`; files deleted after 3 days (non-Enterprise) |

---

## 1. Tripo 3D

Docs: https://developers.tripo3d.ai/en/docs/introduction. `platform.tripo3d.ai/docs/*` now redirects (302) to `developers.tripo3d.ai`. Every page also has a Markdown version: append `.md`, for example `https://developers.tripo3d.ai/en/docs/task-query.md`. The full index is at https://developers.tripo3d.ai/llms.txt.

### Auth
- One API key, created at https://developers.tripo3d.ai/en/keys and shown only once.
- Header: `Authorization: Bearer {api_key}`, plus `Content-Type: application/json` on JSON POSTs.
- Format: the docs' examples (CLI, SDK, ComfyUI pages) all show `tsk_...`, for example `TRIPO_API_KEY=tsk_XXXXXXX`. **[UNCONFIRMED]** The prefix is never stated as a formal rule, so don't hard-reject keys that lack it. At most, warn.
- Regions: international is `developers.tripo3d.ai` / `openapi.tripo3d.ai`. China mainland accounts use `developers.tripo3d.com`, and keys are region-bound: the CLI "probes both regions". **[UNCONFIRMED]** The China API host isn't given in the pages I read.

### Base URL and envelope
`https://openapi.tripo3d.ai/v3` (API v3 is current; v2 was `https://api.tripo3d.ai/v2/openapi/`).

Success:
```json
{ "code": 0, "data": { ... } }
```
Error (HTTP 4xx/5xx):
```json
{ "code": 2010, "status": "error", "message": "You don't have enough credit to create this task",
  "suggestion": "Please purchase more credit", "request_id": "req_abc123" }
```
Main request error codes:

| code | HTTP | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 2, 1002 | 401 | auth missing or invalid |
| 1003 | 400 | malformed body |
| 1004 | 400 | invalid or missing parameter |
| 1007 | 429 | rate limit |
| 2000 | 429 | concurrency limit (has `Retry-After`) |
| 2001 | 404 | task not found |
| 2003 / 2004 | 400 | empty or unsupported file |
| 2008 | 400 | content policy |
| 2010 | 403 | insufficient credits |
| 2015 | 400 | version deprecated |
| 2018 | 400 | model too complex |
| 1000 / 1001 | 500 | server error |

A failed task has its own `error_code` and `error_message`. These numbers are a separate space from the request codes above.

### Endpoints (all POST JSON unless noted; all return `{"code":0,"data":{"task_id":"<uuid>"}}`)

| Capability | Endpoint | Task `type` |
|---|---|---|
| Text → 3D (H or P series) | `POST /v3/generation/text-to-model` | `text_to_model` |
| Image → 3D | `POST /v3/generation/image-to-model` | `image_to_model` |
| Multiview (2–4 images) → 3D | `POST /v3/generation/multiview-to-model` | `multiview_to_model` |
| Image → Gaussian splat (.splat) | `POST /v3/generation/image-to-splat` | `image_to_splat` |
| Text → image | `POST /v3/generation/text-to-image` | `text_to_image` |
| Image → image | `POST /v3/generation/image-to-image` | |
| Image → 4 multiview images | `POST /v3/generation/image-to-multiview` | `image_to_multiview` |
| Edit multiview | `POST /v3/generation/edit-multiview` | `edit_multiview` |
| Texture / retexture | `POST /v3/models/texture` | `texture_model` |
| Format conversion | `POST /v3/models/convert` | `convert_model` |
| Import external model | `POST /v3/models/import` | `import_model` |
| Rig check (free) | `POST /v3/animations/rig-check` | `animate_prerigcheck` |
| Auto rig | `POST /v3/animations/rig` | `animate_rig` |
| Animation retarget (presets) | `POST /v3/animations/retarget` | `animate_retarget` |
| Part segmentation | `POST /v3/mesh/segment` | `mesh_segmentation` |
| Part completion | `POST /v3/mesh/complete` | `mesh_completion` |
| Retopology / decimate | `POST /v3/mesh/decimate` | `highpoly_to_lowpoly` |
| Smart segmentation (image or GLB, includes modeling) | `POST /v3/mesh/smartsegment` | `smartsegment_image` / `_model` |
| Smart UV | `POST /v3/mesh/uv` | `mesh_uv` |
| Task query | `GET /v3/tasks/{task_id}` | |
| Batch task query (≤100) | `POST /v3/tasks/list` `{"task_ids":[...]}` → `data.tasks{id:task}`, `data.missed[]` | |
| Upload (multipart) | `POST /v3/files` | |
| Presigned upload (large) | `POST /v3/files/presign` | |
| Balance | `GET /v3/account/balance` | |
| Usage | `GET /v3/account/usage`, `GET /v3/account/usage/history` (≤31-day window, cursor paging, ≤100/page) | |

Refine and stylize (`/v3/models/refine`, `/v3/models/stylize`) are **retired**: the SDK page says they "are not listed as supported". Tripo has no stylize endpoint now.

### Model versions (as of 2026-11-14)
- **Geometry, H series** (`model` is **required** on text, image and multiview): `v3.1-20260211` (recommended, latest), `v3.0-20250812`, `v2.5-20250123` (legacy).
- **Geometry, P series** (clean, low-poly topology): `P2-20260801` (native quads; 48–50,000 tris or 48–25,000 quads) and `P1-20260311` (50–20,000 faces). Same endpoints, different `model` value.
- **Texture** (`texture_version` on generation, `model` on `/models/texture`): `v3.5-20260815` (newest; needed for `texture_quality:"fast"` and `delight`), `v3.0-20250812` (default for v3.x and P), `v2.5-20250123`.
- **Rig**: `v1.0-20240301` (default; biped, 90+ `preset:biped:*`), `v2.5-20260210` (non-humanoid), `v3.0-20260909` (recommended for humanoids; must be requested explicitly).
- **Segmentation**: `v1.0-20250506` (default), `v2.0-20260430` (beta, semantic). Retopology: `v1.0`, `v2.0` (default), `v3.0`.
- **Image models**: `seedream_v4` (text-to-image default), `seedream_v5` (image-to-image default), `banana`, `banana_pro`, `banana2`, `chat_image_1` (retired 2026-10-23), `chat_image_1.5` (retiring 2026-12-01), `chat_image_2`, `chat_image_2.5_flare`, `chat_image_2.5_sunburst`.

### Request bodies

**Text → 3D** (`/v3/generation/text-to-model`):
```json
{
  "prompt": "A cat wearing a spacesuit",       // required, ≤1024 chars
  "model": "v3.1-20260211",                    // required
  "negative_prompt": "blurry, broken mesh",    // ≤255 chars
  "texture": true,                             // default true
  "pbr": true,                                 // default true; forces texture=true
  "texture_quality": "standard",               // fast | standard | detailed | extreme (8K)
  "texture_version": "v3.5-20260815",          // optional
  "delight": true,                             // v3.5 texture only
  "geometry_quality": "standard",              // standard | detailed (Ultra); v3.x only
  "face_limit": 80000,                         // omit = adaptive
  "quad": false,                               // true forces FBX output; default 10k faces
  "smart_low_poly": false,                     // 500–20k tri / 500–10k quad
  "generate_parts": false,                     // needs texture=false, pbr=false
  "auto_size": false,                          // real-world meters
  "compress": "geometry",                      // meshopt
  "export_uv": true,
  "export_orientation": "+x",                  // +x | -x | +y | -y (avoid if you post-process)
  "model_seed": 1, "image_seed": 1, "texture_seed": 1
}
```
- `face_limit` maximums: v3.1 1.5M (Ultra 2M), v3.0 1M (Ultra 2M), v2.5 500k, quad 150k.
- `texture_quality`, `geometry_quality`, `auto_size`, `quad`, `smart_low_poly`, `generate_parts` and `compress` need a model of v3.0 or later.

**Image → 3D** (`/v3/generation/image-to-model`): the same texture and geometry fields as text, minus `prompt`, `negative_prompt` and `image_seed`, plus:
```json
{
  "input": "https://example.com/photo.png",   // OR "file_abc123" (file_token) OR a text_to_image/image_to_image task_id
  "model": "v3.1-20260211",
  "enable_image_autofix": false,
  "texture_alignment": "original_image",       // original_image | geometry
  "orientation": "default"                     // default | align_image (only with texture)
}
```
Input images are PNG, JPEG or WebP, ≤20 MB, recommended ≥256×256. One string carries any of the three input kinds; the server works out which. **Base64 is not accepted.** Upload the file first.

The P series takes `input`, `model: "P1-20260311"|"P2-20260801"`, `face_limit`, texture fields and `quad` (P2 only). It has no `geometry_quality`, `smart_low_poly` or `generate_parts`.

**Multiview → 3D** (`/v3/generation/multiview-to-model`) uses `inputs` instead of `input`. Pick one form:
```json
{ "inputs": [ {"front": "https://.../front.png"}, {"back": "file_abc123"}, {"right": "https://.../r.png"} ],
  "model": "v3.1-20260211" }
```
- View-key objects can have keys `front`, `left`, `back` and `right`. A value can be a URL, a file_token, or `{url}` / `{file_token}` / `{object:{bucket,key}}`.
- Positional form: exactly 4 strings in the order `[front, left, back, right]`, with `""` for a missing view.
- Previous-task form: `[{"task_id":"<image_to_multiview task>"}]`.
- Front is required, with at least 2 images.

**Texture** (`/v3/models/texture`):
```json
{ "input": "<task_id | file_token | url>",           // GLB/GLTF/FBX/OBJ/STL ≤150 MB
  "model": "v3.0-20250812",
  "texture_prompt": { "text": "worn leather" },      // OR {"image": {...}} OR {"images":[{"front":...},...]}; style_image allowed with text
  "pbr": true, "texture_quality": "detailed", "texture_alignment": "original_image",
  "part_names": ["tripo_part_0"], "bake": true, "delight": true, "texture_seed": 1, "compress": "geometry" }
```

**Convert** (`/v3/models/convert`):
```json
{ "input": "<task_id | file_token | url>",
  "format": "FBX",                 // GLTF | FBX | USDZ | OBJ | STL | 3MF
  "quad": false, "force_symmetry": false, "face_limit": 20000,
  "flatten_bottom": false, "flatten_bottom_threshold": 0.01,
  "texture_size": 4096, "texture_format": "JPEG",   // JPEG|PNG|WEBP|BMP|DPX|HDR|OPEN_EXR|TARGA|TIFF
  "bake": true, "pack_uv": false, "export_vertex_colors": false,
  "pivot_to_center_bottom": false, "scale_factor": 1, "with_animation": true,
  "animate_in_place": false, "part_names": [], "export_orientation": "+x",
  "fbx_preset": "blender",         // blender | 3dsmax | mixamo | bake_scale
  "texture_packaging": "embedded"  // FBX only: embedded | zip
}
```
Setting options to non-default values bills "Advanced" convert (10 credits instead of 5).

**Rig check** `{"input": "..."}` → output `{"riggable": true, "rig_type": "biped"}`. The rig types are biped, quadruped, hexapod, octopod, avian, serpentine and aquatic.

**Rig** body:
```json
{ "input": "...", "model": "v3.0-20260909", "rig_type": "biped",
  "spec": "mixamo", "out_format": "glb" }
```
- `rig_type` adds `others` on v3.0.
- `spec` (biped only): `tripo`, `mixamo`, `actorcore`, `unity`, `unreal`, `vrm`.
- `out_format`: `glb` or `fbx`.
- Input: GLB, FBX, OBJ or STL, ≤150 MB.

**Retarget** body:
```json
{ "input": "<rig task_id>", "animation": "preset:walk", "out_format": "glb",
  "export_with_geometry": true, "animate_in_place": false }
```
- Send `animation` (one) or `animations: [...]` (≤5), not both.
- v3.0 biped presets: `preset:idle|walk|run|dive|climb|jump|slash|shoot|hurt|fall|turn`.
- Other rigs: `preset:quadruped:walk`, `preset:hexapod:walk`, `preset:octopod:walk`, `preset:serpentine:march`, `preset:aquatic:march`.
- v1.0 rigs: 90+ `preset:biped:*` presets.

**Segment** body: `{"input", "model", "segmentation_granularity": "simple|balanced|detailed", "split_by_connectivity": true, "ref_image": "<url|file_token>"}`. The last three are v2 only.

**Complete** body: `{"input": "<segment task_id>", "part_names": [], "completion_mode": "ai_completion|quick_cap"}`.

**Decimate** body: `{"input", "model": "v3.0", "face_limit": 5000, "quad": false, "smart_uv": false, "bake": true, "part_names": []}`. On v3.0, `face_limit` is 500–20k (tris) or 500–10k (quads). `smart_uv` works on v3.0 only.

**Smart UV** body: `{"input", "bake": true, "export_orientation", "compress"}`. The input model must be ≤80,000 equivalent triangles.

**Smart segment** body: `{"seg_type": "image|model", "input", "granularity": "coarse|medium|fine", "hint": "...", "transform": [16 floats, column-major]}`. `transform` is required for `model`, and the model must be GLB.

**Image → splat** body: `{"input": "<url|file_token>", "model_seed": 1}`.

### File upload
`POST /v3/files` as `multipart/form-data` with field `file`:
- Images: JPEG or PNG, ≤20 MB.
- Models: GLB, GLTF, FBX, OBJ or STL, ≤150 MB.
- Response: `{"code":0,"data":{"file_token":"file_abc123"}}`.
- **[UNCONFIRMED]** Text-to-3D accepts WebP image inputs by URL, but the upload page lists only JPEG and PNG for images.

`POST /v3/files/presign` with `{"format":"glb"}` is for large files (>60 MB recommended):
- Response: `{"presigned_url":"https://...X-Amz-Signature=...", "file_token":"file_...", "expires_in":1800}`.
- Then `PUT presigned_url` with `Content-Type: application/octet-stream` and no auth.
- `expires_in` "currently differs from the URL signature expiry". Upload immediately.
- Allowed formats: jpeg/jpg/png/webp/bmp/tiff and glb/gltf/fbx/obj/stl/3mf/usdz.

### Async pattern
`GET /v3/tasks/{task_id}`:
```json
{ "code": 0, "data": {
  "task_id": "123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000", "type": "text_to_model",
  "status": "success", "progress": 100,
  "output": { "model_url": "https://cdn.tripo3d.ai/output/model_pbr.glb",
              "rendered_image_url": "https://cdn.tripo3d.ai/output/preview.png" },
  "credits_consumed": 30.00,
  "error_code": null, "error_message": null,
  "created_at": "2026-04-28T12:00:00Z", "completed_at": "2026-04-28T12:01:30Z" } }
```
- **Statuses:** `queued` (progress 0), `running` (0–100), then the terminal ones: `success`, `failed`, `cancelled`. Also treat legacy `banned` and `expired` as terminal. If you see `unknown`, keep polling with a timeout.
- **Polling:** the docs recommend every 1–2 s, with a timeout (they suggest about 5 min), and `POST /v3/tasks/list` for many tasks.
- **Output keys:**
  - `model_url` on most tasks. The SDK says `model` and `pbr_model` are kept as compatibility aliases.
  - `rendered_image_url` is the preview.
  - Image tasks return `generated_image_url`; multiview returns `front_view_url` / `left_view_url` / `back_view_url` / `right_view_url`.
  - Smart UV returns `uv_render_url`. Smart segment returns `mask_url` and `seg_model_url`.
  - Rig check returns `riggable` and `rig_type`.
  - Import and post-processing tasks with a file_token or URL input also return `normalize_scale` and `normalize_translation`.
- **Output formats:** generation returns GLB (`quad:true` forces FBX). Rig and retarget return GLB or FBX via `out_format`. Splat returns `.splat`. Other formats come from `/v3/models/convert`: GLTF, FBX, USDZ, OBJ, STL, 3MF.
- **URL lifetime:** **[UNCONFIRMED]** It isn't documented. The SDK page says "Do not store a temporary signed URL as a permanent asset" and suggests re-querying the task for a fresh URL. Download right away.
- **Webhooks:** `task.completed`, `task.failed` and `balance.low`. You configure them in the console (Settings → Webhooks); they need a public HTTPS endpoint, so they're of little use to a desktop app.
  - Header `Tripo-Webhook-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex>`, where v1 = HMAC-SHA256(secret `whsec_…`, `t + "." + rawBody`).
  - Deduplicate on `Tripo-Webhook-Delivery`.

### Validating a key for free
`GET https://openapi.tripo3d.ai/v3/account/balance` with the Bearer header returns:
```json
{ "code": 0, "data": { "balance": 10000.00, "frozen": 200.00 } }
```
- Both values are in credits, with 2 decimals. `frozen` is credits held for running tasks.
- An invalid key gives HTTP 401 with code 2 or 1002.
- A wrong region (CN key against the .ai host) presumably also gives 401. **[UNCONFIRMED]**

### Pricing and limits
- **Credit model:** prepaid credits at 1 credit = US$0.01. From 2026-12-01 the console shows USD, but API fields stay in credits.
- **Billing:** credits are frozen at task creation, deducted on success, and released on failure or cancel.
- **Prices** (from https://developers.tripo3d.ai/en/pricing; the page rendered garbled, so the base prices are inferred **[UNCONFIRMED]**):
  - Text→3D: 10 without texture, 20 with standard texture.
  - Image→3D and multiview: 20 without texture, 30 with texture.
  - Add-ons: HD texture +10, Ultra (8K) texture +20, detailed geometry +20, quad +5, smart low-poly +10, generate parts +20.
  - Texture task: 10 (fast/standard), 20 (HD), 30 (8K).
  - Convert: 5 basic, 10 advanced.
  - Retopology: v3.0 35 (tri) or 40 (quad), v2.0 30, v1.0 10.
  - Smart UV 20, segmentation 40, completion 50 (quick cap 30), smart segmentation 85 (image) or 55 (model).
  - Rig check free, auto rig 25, retarget 10 per animation.
  - Image→multiview 10.
  - Always read the real cost from `credits_consumed`.
- **Rate limits:**
  - Per API key, varying by endpoint. HTTP 429 with code 1007.
  - Headers: `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset` (unix seconds).
  - The numeric rates per endpoint aren't published.
- **Concurrency** (per account, per category; 429 with code 2000 and `Retry-After`):
  - H-series 3D generation: 10
  - P-series 3D generation: 5
  - Image generation: 1
  - Animation: 10
  - Model processing (texture, convert): 5
  - Mesh operations: 10

## 2. Tencent Hunyuan 3D ("Tencent HY 3D Global" on the international site)

There are three routes. Pick one per account type:

| Route | Account | Host | Auth | Coverage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **A. International Tencent Cloud** (recommended for a global app) | tencentcloud.com | `hunyuan.intl.tencentcloudapi.com`, API version `2023-09-01` | SecretId + SecretKey, TC3-HMAC-SHA256 | All 3D APIs listed below |
| B. China Tencent Cloud, signed | cloud.tencent.com (China real-name) | `ai3d.tencentcloudapi.com`, version `2025-05-13`, Region `ap-guangzhou` | SecretId + SecretKey, TC3 | Same plus extras (text-to-motion, 3D character) |
| C. China Tencent Cloud, **API key** ("OpenAI-compatible") | cloud.tencent.com (China) | `https://api.ai3d.cloud.tencent.com` | single key `sk-...` in `Authorization` | **Pro edition only** (submit and query) |

- **Simpler API-key route (C):**
  - Documented only on the **China** site (product 1804): "OpenAI 兼容接口" plus "API Key 管理".
  - Endpoints: `POST https://api.ai3d.cloud.tencent.com/v1/ai3d/submit` and `POST https://api.ai3d.cloud.tencent.com/v1/ai3d/query`.
  - The header is `Authorization: sk-A***ZZZ`. The docs' example has **no "Bearer" prefix**.
  - The body uses the same fields as `SubmitHunyuanTo3DProJob` / `QueryHunyuanTo3DProJob`, e.g. `{"Prompt":"小狗"}` or `{"JobId":"1387416933258346496"}`.
  - On this route `ImageUrl` also accepts `data:image/jpeg;base64,...`.
  - The China pages also warn that Hunyuan model features are moving to "TokenHub", and the old platform won't take new model purchases.
  - **[UNCONFIRMED]** I found no equivalent API-key route on the international site (tencentcloud.com product 1284 lists only signed APIs).
  - **[UNCONFIRMED]** I couldn't read 3d.hunyuan.tencent.com. It's a JS app; the fetch came back empty, and I found no public API docs there.
- Everything below is route A unless marked otherwise.

### Auth (route A)
- **Credentials:**
  - Key pair from https://console.tencentcloud.com/cam/capi. The SecretId looks like `AKID` + 32 chars; the SecretKey is 32 chars, shown only at creation.
  - You also need a **Region** value. Intl region list for this product: `ap-singapore`, `eu-frankfurt`, `na-siliconvalley`.
  - Sub-accounts need CAM policy `QcloudAI3DFullAccess`.
  - The service must be activated in the Tencent HY console first. If it isn't, calls fail with `FailedOperation.ServiceNotActivated`.
- **Request:**
  - Always `POST https://hunyuan.intl.tencentcloudapi.com/` with the JSON body holding only the action's own parameters.
  - Headers:
    ```
    Host: hunyuan.intl.tencentcloudapi.com
    Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
    X-TC-Action: SubmitHunyuanTo3DProJob
    X-TC-Version: 2023-09-01
    X-TC-Region: ap-singapore
    X-TC-Timestamp: 1731571200            (unix seconds; must be within 5 min of server time)
    Authorization: TC3-HMAC-SHA256 Credential=AKID.../2026-11-14/hunyuan/tc3_request, SignedHeaders=content-type;host, Signature=<hex>
    ```
  - Optional: `X-TC-Token` for temporary credentials.
  - POST bodies can be up to 10 MB with TC3.
  - Regional hosts also exist, e.g. `hunyuan.ap-singapore.tencentcloudapi.com`. The docs recommend `hunyuan.intl.tencentcloudapi.com` (routes to the nearest region).
- **TC3-HMAC-SHA256 signing** (from the "Signature v3" page; the docs include a full .NET sample):
  ```
  CanonicalRequest = "POST\n/\n\n" +
                     "content-type:application/json; charset=utf-8\nhost:hunyuan.intl.tencentcloudapi.com\n\n" +
                     "content-type;host\n" +
                     lowerhex(SHA256(body))
  Date            = UTC date of X-TC-Timestamp, "yyyy-MM-dd"   // must be UTC, not local
  CredentialScope = Date + "/hunyuan/tc3_request"
  StringToSign    = "TC3-HMAC-SHA256\n" + timestamp + "\n" + CredentialScope + "\n" + lowerhex(SHA256(CanonicalRequest))
  kDate    = HMAC_SHA256(UTF8("TC3" + SecretKey), Date)
  kService = HMAC_SHA256(kDate, "hunyuan")
  kSigning = HMAC_SHA256(kService, "tc3_request")
  Signature = lowerhex(HMAC_SHA256(kSigning, StringToSign))
  Authorization = "TC3-HMAC-SHA256 Credential=" + SecretId + "/" + CredentialScope +
                  ", SignedHeaders=content-type;host, Signature=" + Signature
  ```
  - The `service` must "match the domain name of the product called", so it's `hunyuan` for `hunyuan.intl.tencentcloudapi.com`. **[UNCONFIRMED]** This is inferred from that rule; no page shows it literally for this host. For billing it would be `billing`; for China route B, `ai3d`.
  - The Content-Type header you send must be exactly the string you signed.
  - Official .NET SDK: https://github.com/TencentCloud/tencentcloud-sdk-dotnet-intl-en. Hand-rolling the signer is simple enough, though.
- **Response envelope** (always HTTP 200 with a `Response` object):
  ```json
  { "Response": { "JobId": "1422504058612350976", "RequestId": "c942d2da-..." } }
  { "Response": { "Error": { "Code": "AuthFailure.SignatureFailure", "Message": "..." }, "RequestId": "..." } }
  ```
  - Check for `Response.Error`.
  - Auth codes: `AuthFailure.SecretIdNotFound`, `AuthFailure.SignatureFailure`, `AuthFailure.SignatureExpire` (clock skew), `AuthFailure.InvalidSecretId`, `AuthFailure.UnauthorizedOperation`.
  - Business codes: `FailedOperation.FreeResourcePackExhausted`, `FailedOperation.ResourcePackExhausted`, `FailedOperation.ServiceNotActivated`, `FailedOperation.ServiceStopArrears`, `FailedOperation.EngineServerLimitExceeded`, `FailedOperation.EngineRequestTimeout`, `InvalidParameterValue.Model`.
  - Other: `LimitExceeded`, `RequestLimitExceeded`, `UnsupportedRegion`.

### Actions (international, version 2023-09-01)

| Capability | Submit action | Poll action | Default concurrency |
|---|---|---|---|
| Text/image/multiview/sketch → 3D, **Pro** | `SubmitHunyuanTo3DProJob` | `QueryHunyuanTo3DProJob` | 3 |
| Text/image → 3D, **Rapid** ("Express") | `SubmitHunyuanTo3DRapidJob` | `QueryHunyuanTo3DRapidJob` | 1 |
| Part (component) generation | `SubmitHunyuan3DPartJob` | `QueryHunyuan3DPartJob` | 1 |
| Smart topology (retopo / low-poly) | `Submit3DSmartTopologyJob` | `Describe3DSmartTopologyJob` | 1 |
| Texture edit (retexture) | `SubmitHunyuanTo3DTextureEditJob` | `QueryHunyuanTo3DTextureEditJob` | 1 |
| UV unfold | `SubmitHunyuanTo3DUVJob` | `DescribeHunyuanTo3DUVJob` | 1 |
| Auto rigging + preset motion | `SubmitAutoRiggingJob` | `DescribeAutoRiggingJob` | 1 |
| Format conversion (async) | `SubmitConvert3DFormatJob` | `DescribeConvert3DFormatJob` | 1 |
| Format conversion (sync) | `Convert3DFormat` → returns `ResultFile3D` directly | | |

- Every action allows 20 requests/s.
- Concurrency is shared by the main account and its sub-accounts. Add-on packages cost 5,000 USD per concurrency per month.
- China route B also has text-to-motion (`文生动作`) and 3D character generation (`3D 人物生成`). I didn't fetch their parameters.

### Model versions
- Pro: `"Model": "3.0"` (default) or `"3.1"`. With 3.1, `LowPoly` and `Sketch` are unavailable.
- Rapid: no model parameter.
- No other version names are exposed.

### Request bodies

**SubmitHunyuanTo3DProJob**:
```json
{
  "Model": "3.1",
  "Prompt": "a cat",                      // ≤1024 chars; XOR with ImageUrl/ImageBase64 (except Sketch)
  "ImageUrl": "https://.../in.png",        // OR "ImageBase64": "<base64>"; jpg/png/jpeg/webp, sides 128–5000 px, ≤8 MB (≈6 MB raw for base64)
  "MultiViewImages": [ { "ViewType": "back", "ViewImageUrl": "https://..." },
                       { "ViewType": "left", "ViewImageBase64": "<base64>" } ],
  "EnablePBR": false,
  "FaceCount": 500000,                     // 3000–1,500,000, default 500,000
  "GenerateType": "Normal",                // Normal | LowPoly | Geometry (untextured, GLB only) | Sketch
  "PolygonType": "triangle"                // LowPoly only: triangle | quadrilateral
}
```
- `MultiViewImages` (the docs write it `MultiViewImages.N`) is the main image plus extra views. `ViewType` values are `left`, `right` and `back`; 3.1 adds `top`, `bottom`, `left_front` and `right_front`. One image per view, JPG or PNG.
- **[UNCONFIRMED]** The China doc also lists `ResultFormat` (`STL|USDZ|FBX`; default output is obj + glb). The international page doesn't list it.
- **[UNCONFIRMED]** `ImageBase64` looks like raw base64 without a `data:` prefix (the China example value is `/9j/4Q...`). Only the API-key route documents `data:` URIs.

**SubmitHunyuanTo3DRapidJob**:
```json
{ "Prompt": "...", "ImageUrl": "...", "ImageBase64": "...",
  "ResultFormat": "GLB", "EnablePBR": false, "EnableGeometry": false }
```
- `Prompt` is ≤200 chars and can't be combined with an image.
- `ImageBase64` must be ≤6 MB and `ImageUrl` ≤8 MB; image sides 128–5000 px.
- `ResultFormat` values: `OBJ|GLB|STL|USDZ|FBX|MP4|GIF`. USDZ, MP4 and GIF may time out.
- `EnableGeometry` produces an untextured mesh: GLB by default, OBJ not allowed.

**Post-processing:** model inputs are always `InputFile3D` = `{"Type": "FBX", "Url": "https://..."}`. They are **URLs only**: Tencent has no upload API, so a local file has to be hosted somewhere (e.g. COS or S3 with a presigned URL) first.

| Action | Body fields |
|---|---|
| `SubmitHunyuan3DPartJob` | `File` (**FBX only**, ≤200 MB, ≤1.5M faces), `PartSegmentationInfo` (JSON string, see below), `EnableStagedGeneration` (bool), `EnablePostProcess` (bool, +20 credits; returns one model link) |
| `Submit3DSmartTopologyJob` | `File3D` (glb or obj, ≤200 MB; works best on non-topologized high-poly AIGC meshes), `PolygonType` (`triangle` \| `quadrilateral`), `FaceLevel` (`high` \| `medium` \| `low`) |
| `SubmitHunyuanTo3DTextureEditJob` | `File3D` (**FBX**, <200 MB); then either `Prompt` (≤1024 chars) or `Image` (`{"Url":...}` or `{"Base64":...}`; jpg/jpeg/png, sides 128–4096, base64 <10 MB; Url wins if both are sent); `EnablePBR` (only with Prompt) |
| `SubmitHunyuanTo3DUVJob` | `File` (FBX, OBJ or GLB; <30,000 faces, ≤100 connected components) |
| `SubmitAutoRiggingJob` | `File3D` (FBX or OBJ, ≤60 MB, **T-pose** character or animal), `MotionType` (integer 1–48, see below) |
| `SubmitConvert3DFormatJob` | `File` (FBX, OBJ or GLB ≤200 MB; OBJ must be a zip with obj, mtl and textures), `Format` (`STL\|USDZ\|FBX\|MP4\|GIF`; the docs' example uses `OBJ`) |
| `Convert3DFormat` (sync) | `File3D` (**string** URL; fbx, obj or glb ≤60 MB), `Format` (`STL\|USDZ\|FBX\|MP4\|GIF`) → `{"ResultFile3D": "https://...stl"}` |

The Part job's `PartSegmentationInfo` looks like this:
```json
{"MeshName_part_1": {"face_ids": [1, 2, 3], "color": "#FF805C"}}
```

`MotionType` values for `SubmitAutoRiggingJob`:
- Combat: 1 Roundhouse Kick, 2 Left Hook, 3 Charged Attack, 4 Charged Punch, 5 Two-Hit Combo, 6 Two-Hit Combo 2, 15 Throat Slash, 16 Jab, 17 Continuous Strikes, 18 Kick, 19 Side Kick, 39 Sliding Tackle, 48 Send Shockwave
- Reactions: 7 Backstep, 8–10 Hit Reaction 1–3, 11–12 Knockdown 1–2, 13 Landing, 14 Dejection, 43 Intimidation, 44 Fall Forward
- Locomotion: 23–25 Walk 1–3, 32–33 Jog 1–2, 34 Run, 35–37 Sprint 1–3
- Idle and turns: 26–27 Idle 1–2, 22 Crouching Turn, 30 Turn Left, 31 and 45 Turn Right, 47 Turn Around
- Jumps and acrobatics: 21 Backflip, 38 and 46 Jump (In Place) 1–2, 40–41 Long Jump 1–2, 42 Vault
- Dance and other: 20 Tai Chi, 28 Street Dance, 29 The Twist

### Async pattern
- **Submit** returns `{"Response":{"JobId":"1335141824121323520","RequestId":"..."}}`. A JobId is valid for 24 h.
- **Poll** with the matching Query/Describe action and `{"JobId":"..."}`:
  ```json
  { "Response": {
      "Status": "DONE",                       // WAIT | RUN | DONE | FAIL
      "ErrorCode": "", "ErrorMessage": "",
      "ResultFile3Ds": [
        { "Type": "OBJ", "Url": "https://xxx.cos.ap-guangzhou.tencentcos.cn/xxx.zip", "PreviewImageUrl": "https://...png" },
        { "Type": "GLB", "Url": "https://..." }
      ],
      "RequestId": "..." } }
  ```
- `File3D.Type` takes values like `OBJ`, `GLB`, `FBX`, `STL`, `USDZ`, `GIF`, `MP4` and `IMAGE` (part, texture-edit and UV results include a PNG as `IMAGE`). The OBJ result is a **zip** (obj + mtl + textures).
- `QueryHunyuan3DPartJob` also returns `PartSegmentationInfo`.
- **URL lifetime:** "valid for 24 hours" / "1 day". The URLs are COS presigned (`q-sign-time=...`), so download immediately.
- **No webhooks and no streaming.** Poll; the docs give no polling interval, so something like 3–5 s is reasonable.
- **Output formats:**
  - Pro: OBJ (zip) + GLB by default.
  - Rapid: as `ResultFormat`.
  - Convert: STL, USDZ, FBX, MP4 (turntable), GIF.

### Validating credentials for free
- **No documented balance or credit endpoint** for Hunyuan 3D credits. Free and prepaid packages are visible only in the console ("Resource Package Management").
- The cheapest documented check is the Tencent Cloud billing API `DescribeAccountBalance`:
  - Host `billing.intl.tencentcloudapi.com`, version `2018-07-09`, Region not required. Signed with service name `billing`.
  - Body `{}` or `{"TempCredit":true}`.
  - Returns `{"Response":{"Balance":0,"RealBalance":0,"CreditBalance":...,"FreezeAmount":0,"OweAmount":0,"Uin":...,"RequestId":"..."}}`. Amounts are in cents.
  - An `AuthFailure.*` error means the key pair is bad.
  - Caveats: it validates the **key pair, not 3D activation**, and a sub-account without billing permission gets `AuthFailure.UnauthorizedOperation`, even though its key may be fine for 3D.
- Alternative: call `QueryHunyuanTo3DProJob` with a dummy JobId.
  - **[UNCONFIRMED]** The exact error for a nonexistent job isn't documented.
  - Any `AuthFailure.*` means bad credentials. `FailedOperation.ServiceNotActivated` means the service isn't activated. A different error (parameter or not-found) most likely means the auth is fine.
  - Query calls aren't billed: only successful generations deduct credits.

### Pricing (international, Billing Overview updated 2026-05-08)
- **Credits:**
  - Free tier: 200 credits per user on first activation, valid 1 year.
  - Prepaid packs: 1k for $15, 10k for $145, 50k for $700, 100k for $1,350.
  - Postpaid: $0.02 per credit, billed daily. It must be enabled under Console → Settings → Postpaid, otherwise you get a billing error once the packs run out.
  - Failed tasks are free.
- **Pro credit costs:** Normal 25, LowPoly 30, Geometry 15, Sketch 25. Add-ons: MultiViewImages +10, EnablePBR +10, FaceCount +10. The Model version costs nothing extra.
- **Rapid credit costs:** 15, plus EnablePBR +10.
- **Post-processing credit costs:** Part 30, Smart Topology 50, Texture Edit 30, UV 10, Auto Rigging 10, Convert 5.
- China pricing differs: Pro Normal is 20 credits, and ResultFormat costs +5. Packs run ¥0.09–0.1 per credit; postpaid is ¥0.12 per credit.
- **Rate limits:** 20 req/s per action, plus the default concurrency in the table above.

## 3. Meshy

Docs: https://docs.meshy.ai/en/api.
- Every page has a Markdown version at `https://docs.meshy.ai/api/<page>.md`.
- Index: https://docs.meshy.ai/llms.txt; everything in one file: https://docs.meshy.ai/llms-full.txt.
- OpenAPI spec: https://docs.meshy.ai/openapi.yaml (JSON at `/openapi.json`). It's worth generating C# models from it. Creative Lab and Text-to-Motion aren't in the spec.

### Auth
- One API key in the format `msy_<random>`, e.g. `msy_sOmEbOgUsApIkEyFoReXaMpLe1234567890`.
- Created at https://www.meshy.ai/developers/keys and shown once. You can set a per-key monthly credit limit and an IP allowlist (a refused address gets 403 `ip_not_authorized`).
- Header: `Authorization: Bearer msy_...`. The `Bearer` prefix is required.
- HTTPS only. Plain HTTP gets a 301, and POSTs lose their body on redirect.
- Creating API keys and creating tasks require a **paid plan**. On a free plan, task creation returns 402.
- The old shared test-mode key was **retired on 2026-09-16** and now returns 401.

### Base URL and errors
- Base URL: `https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/` (paths below are relative to `https://api.meshy.ai`).
- A request error is an HTTP status with a body like `{"message": "Invalid model file extension: .3dm"}`:
  - 400: bad parameters (no task created)
  - 401: bad key
  - 402: insufficient credits or free plan
  - 403: moderation or IP
  - 404: not found
  - 409: tried to DELETE an IN_PROGRESS task
  - 429: rate limit (`Rate limit exceeded`) or concurrency (`NoMorePendingTasks…`, which carries no Retry-After)
  - 5xx: server error
- **Don't auto-retry a create** after a timeout or 5xx: there is no idempotency key. Instead, list the newest tasks (`sort_by=-created_at`) after about a minute and check whether it was created.

### Endpoints
Every task resource has the same five operations:
- `POST /…` (create) → `{"result": "<task id>"}`
- `GET /…/:id` → task object
- `GET /…?page_num=1&page_size=10&sort_by=-created_at` (list; page_size ≤100, page_num ≤255)
- `DELETE /…/:id` (refunds only while PENDING; 409 if IN_PROGRESS)
- `GET /…/:id/stream` (SSE)

| Capability | Path |
|---|---|
| Text → 3D (preview = mesh, refine = texture) | `/openapi/v2/text-to-3d` |
| Image → 3D | `/openapi/v1/image-to-3d` |
| Multi-image (1–4) → 3D | `/openapi/v1/multi-image-to-3d` |
| Retexture | `/openapi/v1/retexture` |
| Remesh (topology, polycount, formats) | `/openapi/v1/remesh` |
| Convert format | `/openapi/v1/convert` |
| Resize (physical size) | `/openapi/v1/resize` |
| UV unwrap | `/openapi/v1/uv-unwrap` |
| Rigging (humanoid) | `/openapi/v1/rigging` |
| Animation (preset library or motion clip) | `/openapi/v1/animations` |
| Animation library (GET, free) | `/openapi/v1/animations/library?search=&category=&sub_category=&action_ids=` |
| Text → motion (FBX/BVH clip) | `/openapi/v1/text-to-motion` |
| Text → image / image → image | `/openapi/v1/text-to-image`, `/openapi/v1/image-to-image` |
| Auto split (print parts; segmentation) | `/openapi/v1/print/split` |
| Multi-color print, analyze printability (free), repair printability, relief | see https://docs.meshy.ai/llms.txt |
| Creative Lab products | `/openapi/creative-lab/<product>/v1/prototype` then `/build` |
| Balance | `GET /openapi/v1/balance` |
| Usage export (Studio/Enterprise) | see https://docs.meshy.ai/api/usage |

Meshy has no stylize endpoint. Part segmentation exists only as the 3D-printing Auto Split (`mode: auto | by_parts | by_color`).

### Models (as of 2026-11-14)
- **Geometry (`ai_model`):**
  - `latest` = `meshy-7.1`, `meshy-6`, `meshy-6-lite`.
  - `meshy-7` is deprecated as a geometry model and retires 2026-12-31.
  - With `model_type: "smart-topology"`: `meshy-t2.5` (default; target_polycount 100–30,000, default 15,000) or `meshy-t2` (100–15,000, default 4,000). Both output triangles only.
- **Texture (`texture_model`):** `meshy-7` (PBR, up to 8K, text prompt OK), `meshy-n1` (2K base color from images only; no PBR, no text), `meshy-6-lite` (2K, cheapest), `meshy-6` (default only when `ai_model` is `meshy-6`; the only one that makes an emission map).
- **Default pairing:** `meshy-7.1` + `meshy-7`.
- **Retexture:** the texture model goes in `ai_model`; `latest` = `meshy-7`, and `meshy-7.1` is rejected.

### Request bodies

**Text → 3D preview** (`POST /openapi/v2/text-to-3d`):
```json
{ "mode": "preview", "prompt": "a monster mask",      // prompt ≤800 chars
  "model_type": "standard",                           // standard | smart-topology
  "ai_model": "latest",
  "geometry_resolution": "standard",                  // standard | 2k | 4k (meshy-7.1 only; +5 credits)
  "should_remesh": false, "topology": "triangle",     // triangle | quad
  "target_polycount": 30000, "decimation_mode": 3,    // 1 ultra … 4 low (overrides target_polycount)
  "pose_mode": "t-pose",                              // a-pose | t-pose | omit
  "target_formats": ["glb","fbx"],                    // glb obj fbx stl usdz 3mf (3mf only if listed)
  "moderation": false, "alpha_thumbnail": false, "auto_size": false, "origin_at": "bottom" }
```

**Text → 3D refine** (same endpoint): `{"mode":"refine","preview_task_id":"<succeeded preview>","enable_pbr":true,"texture_resolution":"2k","texture_prompt":"...","texture_image_url":"<url or data URI>","ai_model":"meshy-7","remove_lighting":true,"target_formats":[...]}`.
- `texture_resolution` takes `2k`, `4k` or `8k`.
- Send `texture_prompt` or `texture_image_url`, not both.

**Image → 3D** (`POST /openapi/v1/image-to-3d`):
```json
{ "image_url": "https://.../photo.jpg",        // or "data:image/png;base64,...."; OR "input_task_id" of a text/image-to-image task
  "model_type": "standard", "ai_model": "latest", "geometry_resolution": "standard",
  "should_texture": true, "texture_model": "meshy-7", "enable_pbr": true,
  "texture_resolution": "2k", "texture_prompt": "...", "texture_image_url": "...",
  "should_remesh": false, "topology": "triangle", "target_polycount": 30000,
  "save_pre_remeshed_model": false, "pose_mode": "a-pose",
  "image_enhancement": true, "remove_lighting": true, "moderation": false,
  "target_formats": ["glb"], "auto_size": false, "origin_at": "bottom",
  "alpha_thumbnail": false, "multi_view_thumbnails": false }
```
- Images: JPG/JPEG/PNG/WebP, ≤20 MB, ≥32 px per side, ≤178,956,970 px total.
- Images are inlined as data URIs. There is **no upload endpoint**.

**Multi-image → 3D** (`POST /openapi/v1/multi-image-to-3d`):
- `image_urls` takes 1–4 images (URL or data URI, front first), or `input_task_id`.
- `ai_model` is `meshy-7.1`, `meshy-6` or `meshy-6-lite`. `geometry_resolution` is `standard` or `2k` (no `4k`).
- `texture_model` must be `meshy-7` or `meshy-n1`. Extra field: `texture_image_urls[]`.
- Otherwise it works like Image → 3D.

**Retexture** (`POST /openapi/v1/retexture`):
```json
{ "input_task_id": "<task>",                  // OR "model_url": GLB/glTF/OBJ/FBX/STL ≤400 MB by URL (≤100 MB as data:application/octet-stream;base64,…)
  "text_style_prompt": "...",                 // OR "image_style_url" OR "multiview_image_urls" (1–4, front first)
  "ai_model": "latest", "enable_original_uv": false, "enable_pbr": true,
  "texture_resolution": "2k", "remove_lighting": true, "target_formats": ["glb"] }
```

**Remesh** (`POST /openapi/v1/remesh`): `{"input_task_id"|"model_url", "target_formats":["glb"], "topology":"quad|triangle", "target_polycount":30000, "decimation_mode":1-4}`. `target_formats` also allows `blend` here.

**Convert** (`POST /openapi/v1/convert`): `{"input_task_id"|"model_url", "target_formats":["fbx","usdz"]}`. Formats: glb, fbx, obj, usdz, blend, stl, 3mf.

**UV unwrap** (`POST /openapi/v1/uv-unwrap`): `{"input_task_id"|"model_url"}`.

**Rigging** (`POST /openapi/v1/rigging`):
```json
{ "input_task_id": "<textured humanoid task>",   // OR "model_url" (GLB ≤400 MB URL / 100 MB data URI)
  "height_meters": 1.7,
  "skeleton_template": "meshyrig",               // meshyrig | mixamo | ue5_mannequin | max_biped | unity_humanoid | maya_human_ik | blender_rigify_basic_human | cc5_hd_neutral_base | daz_genesis9
  "include_fingers": false }
```

**Animation** (`POST /openapi/v1/animations`):
```json
{ "rig_task_id": "<rigging task>",
  "action_id": 92,                 // OR "action_ids": [..≤10] (merged into one file) OR "motion_task_id": "<text-to-motion task>"
  "post_process": { "operation_type": "change_fps", "fps": 30 } }   // change_fps | fbx2usdz | extract_armature
```

**Text → motion** (`POST /openapi/v1/text-to-motion`): `{"prompt": "...", "duration": 4, "mode": "prime"}`. `mode` is `prime` (FBX) or `swift` (BVH). The result is `motion_url`.

### Async pattern
- **Lifecycle:** `PENDING` → `IN_PROGRESS` → `SUCCEEDED` | `FAILED` | `CANCELED`.
  - A task can go back from IN_PROGRESS to PENDING (progress resets). That isn't an error.
- **Polling:**
  - Wait the `Retry-After` header's seconds between polls (default 5).
  - Allow up to **60 min** from `created_at` before giving up; busy periods can exceed 20 min.
  - Typical times are on https://docs.meshy.ai/api/task-lifecycle; e.g. Image→3D at 2K on meshy-7.1 takes about 2 min.
- **SSE:** `GET /openapi/v1/image-to-3d/{id}/stream` with `Accept: text/event-stream`. Each `data:` line is the full task JSON.
- **Webhooks:** configured in the dashboard and require a public HTTPS URL, so they don't suit a desktop app.
- **Task object** (Image → 3D example, trimmed):
  ```json
  { "id": "018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578", "type": "image-to-3d",
    "status": "SUCCEEDED", "progress": 100,
    "model_urls": { "glb": "https://assets.meshy.ai/.../model.glb?Expires=...", "fbx": "...", "obj": "...", "mtl": "...",
                    "usdz": "...", "stl": "...", "3mf": "...(only if requested)", "pre_remeshed_glb": "..." },
    "thumbnail_url": "...", "alpha_thumbnail_url": "...", "thumbnail_urls": {"front":"...","right":"...","back":"...","left":"..."},
    "texture_urls": [ { "base_color": "...", "metallic": "...", "normal": "...", "roughness": "...", "emission": "..." } ],
    "created_at": 1692771650657, "started_at": 1692771667037, "finished_at": 1692771669037, "expires_at": 1692771679037,
    "preceding_tasks": 0, "consumed_credits": 30,
    "task_error": null }   // on FAILED: {"type":"invalid_input","code":"image_too_complex","message":"...","doc_url":"..."}
  ```
  - Timestamps are **Unix milliseconds**.
  - A format that wasn't generated has no key at all, so check before reading.
- **Other result shapes:**
  - Rigging: `result.rigged_character_glb_url`, `result.rigged_character_fbx_url`, and `result.basic_animations.{walking,running}_{glb,fbx,armature_glb}_url`.
  - Animation: `result.animation_glb_url`, `result.animation_fbx_url`, plus `processed_usdz_url`, `processed_armature_fbx_url` and `processed_animation_fps_fbx_url` when post-processed.
- **Output formats:** GLB, FBX, OBJ (+MTL), USDZ, STL, 3MF (when listed in `target_formats`), and BLEND via remesh or convert.
- **URL lifetime:** the URLs are signed on `assets.meshy.ai` and stop working at the task's `expires_at`. Text-to-3D tasks have no `expires_at`, but the task itself is deleted 3 days after it finishes.
  - Meshy keeps assets **3 days** for non-Enterprise accounts. Download right away.
  - Don't feed an old signed URL back in as `model_url`. Use `input_task_id` while the task still exists.

### Validating a key for free
`GET https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v1/balance` with `Authorization: Bearer msy_...` is free and doesn't count toward concurrency:
```json
{ "balance": 1000, "monthly_credits": 600, "permanent_credits": 400, "monthly_resets_at": 1793491200000 }
```
- `monthly_resets_at` is Unix ms or `null`.
- An invalid key gives HTTP 401.
- The balance call doesn't prove the plan allows task creation: a free plan gets 402 on create.

### Pricing and limits
- **Prepaid credits.** Charged at create and refunded on FAILED.
- **Generation:**
  - Text→3D preview: 20 (meshy-7.1/6) or 5 (6-lite/T2/T2.5). Refine: 10 at 2K/4K, 15 at 8K.
  - Image→3D and multi-image: 20 mesh-only or 30 with texture (7.1/6); 5 or 15 (6-lite/T2.x); 8K textures cost +5.
  - Ultra geometry: +5.
- **Post-processing and rigging:** Retexture 10 (15 at 8K), Remesh 5, UV unwrap 5, Convert 1, Resize 1, Rigging 5, Animation 3 per action, Text→motion 10 (prime) or 3 (swift).
- **Printing and Creative Lab:** Auto split 10, Relief 20, analyze printability free. Creative Lab prices are on the pricing page.
- **Rate limits (per team):**

  | Plan | Requests/s | Concurrent tasks |
  |---|---|---|
  | Pro | 20 | 10 |
  | Premium | 20 | 30 |
  | Ultra | 20 | 100 |
  | Studio | 20 | 60 (20 on some older plans) |
  | Enterprise | 100 | 100 |

  - Headers: `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset` (seconds) and `Retry-After`.
  - GET, list, stream and balance count toward requests/s but not toward concurrency.

## Implementation notes for the C# client
- **HTTP client:** use one `HttpClient` per service. Tripo and Meshy take a static `Authorization: Bearer` header. Hunyuan needs a per-request `DelegatingHandler` that computes TC3, from the body bytes and `DateTimeOffset.UtcNow`.
- **Body bytes:** serialize the JSON once and sign **those exact bytes**. Don't let `StringContent` re-encode them or append a different `charset` than the one you signed.
- **Normalize statuses:**
  - Tripo: `queued`/`running` = pending; `success` = done; `failed`/`cancelled`/`banned`/`expired` = failed.
  - Hunyuan: `WAIT`/`RUN` = pending; `DONE` = done; `FAIL` = failed.
  - Meshy: `PENDING`/`IN_PROGRESS` = pending; `SUCCEEDED` = done; `FAILED`/`CANCELED` = failed.
- **Download results right away.** None of the three gives permanent URLs: Hunyuan's last 24 h, Meshy keeps files up to 3 days, and Tripo's lifetime isn't documented.
- **Local inputs:**
  - Meshy: send a `data:` URI.
  - Tripo: `POST /v3/files` (multipart), then pass the `file_token`.
  - Hunyuan images: send `ImageBase64`.
  - Hunyuan **model** inputs (post-processing) need a public URL. You can chain Hunyuan outputs by passing the result URL from a previous job's `ResultFile3Ds`, since it's valid for 24 h.
